posts.title: may the new year be kind
posts.description: I built (assembled a pre-built) wooden clock a few years ago that I tracked the past year with (using manually updating knobs for the day, weekday and month). Two quotes printed on the clock feel relevant to me right now: Another year, another season. Change is only time, unchanged is waiting. and Time cannot add to a person's life, but cherishing time can make life more valuable. Both quotes ring
